name: Liverpool City Region
tagline: Ports, power and pixels: from the Mersey docks to the Baltic Triangle.
lsip_title: Liverpool City Region Local Skills Improvement Plan 2026-29
summary: Liverpool City Region's economy spans an historic port, advanced manufacturing and clean energy, Europe's largest biomanufacturing cluster, professional services, tourism and a fast-growing creative scene, but productivity sits around 27% below the UK average and too many residents are locked out of work. This LSIP asks colleges and providers to fix six sector-specific skills gaps, plus one shared problem everywhere: AI and digital confidence.
